title: At the cinema
instructions: Sophie ve kızı sinemada bilet alıyor. Seans saatleri, fiyatlar ve koltuklar karışık; dikkatle dinle. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: Hello. Two tickets for "The Blue Island", please. One adult and one child.

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: For the four o'clock show or the six thirty show?

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: Four o'clock, please. Six thirty is too late for my daughter.

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: I'm sorry, the four o'clock show is full. There are only seats at six thirty.

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: Oh. Is there another film for children at four?

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: Yes, "Space Cats" starts at a quarter past four.

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: OK, two tickets for "Space Cats", then. How much are they?

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: Adults are nine pounds and children are six. So fifteen pounds.

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: Can we sit at the back?

script.speaker: clerk
script.text: The back is full. You can sit in the middle, row F.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Sophie want the six thirty show?
options: It's too late for her daughter.
questions.feedback: Altı buçuk kızı için çok geç (too late for my daughter).
questions.evidence: Six thirty is too late for my daughter.

questions.feedback: Saat dörtteki "The Blue Island" dolu olduğu için "Space Cats" filmine bilet alıyorlar.

questions.prompt: What time does their film start?
questions.feedback: "Space Cats" dördü çeyrek geçe (a quarter past four) başlıyor.
questions.evidence: starts at a quarter past four.

questions.feedback: Yetişkin dokuz, çocuk altı pound; toplam on beş (fifteen pounds).

questions.prompt: Where are they going to sit?
questions.feedback: Arkası dolu; ortada, F sırasında (in the middle, row F) oturacaklar.
questions.evidence: You can sit in the middle, row F.
